author: The Infographics Show
description:
The quest for the fountain of youth has moved from mythology to the laboratory. Is 2026 the year we finally break the biological clock? In today's epic new episode, we dive into the high-stakes world of age reversal as Life Biosciences begins human trials. Discover the science behind the Information Theory of Aging and how a new treatment can erase up to 57% of biological aging in weeks.

But immortality comes with a price. We explore why the early "cures" for aging also can bring on a deadly super cancer the body is unable to fight. From the dream of 150-year lifespans to the terrifying reality of a world where you never stop working, we breakdown the medical, ethical, and economic fallout of the most important scientific trial in history.
